newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Visitors to Hong Kong up 12.3 pct in January.
newsitem.headline: Visitors to Hong Kong up 12.3 pct in January.

text.p: Hong Kong Tourist Association said on Thursday the number of visitors to the British colony reached 988,300 in January, an increase of 12.3 percent versus the same period last year.
Arrivals from Taiwan showed the highest increase, with a rise of 43.1 percent to 161,350, while visitors from China were up 21.4 percent, reaching 221,750, the association said.

Visitors from North America, Australia, New Zealand and the South Pacific also recorded growth. But Europe, Africa and the Middle East arrivals dropped 6.9 percent and visitors from Southeast Asia declined 7.9 percent, it said.
The association attributed the dips to a combination of weak economies in some individual markets within the regions and competition from other destinations.
